$comment: v0.50 editor UX contract. Metric keys are `viewport/document/subject/metric`, measured by scripts/editor-ux/measure.mjs on the production web build in Chromium. `budgets` are the normative limits; `deterministic` budgets do not depend on machine speed; the others are latency budgets in reference-machine milliseconds (see `calibration`). `exceptions` are temporary ceilings for metrics that do not meet their budget yet: each names the delivery issue that removes it. `npm run ux:gate` builds, measures, and fails on any violation of this file. Change budgets or exceptions only through one reviewed update to this file and editor-ux-baseline.md.

calibration.$comment: Duration of the fixed Canvas 2D calibration workload on the v0.49.0 baseline run (GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest, 4 CPUs). Latency metrics are scaled by referenceMs / measured calibration before they are checked, so budgets are in reference-machine milliseconds.
